messages.text: Hi mum

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Hi love, I know you're busy with the new job and I don't want to nag, but your dad and I haven't heard from you properly in nearly three weeks. We saw on your sister's post that you went to Brighton at the weekend, which is lovely, but it would have been nice to hear it from you. Your dad has his hospital appointment on the 14th and he won't say it, but he'd really like you to ring him before then. I'm not cross, I just worry when it goes quiet like this. Could you give us a call one evening this week? Even ten minutes would make his day. Also, are you still coming for Sunday lunch on the 20th? I need to know for the shopping.

note: Close to 700 characters; several requests in one message.
